notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Beware, healers!

The Halloween Crypt is said to be the most haunted place in the world, and it opened its door (forever) in this Halloween update. Are you ready to discover this new place, and to help Beauty getting over his ghostophobia?

Decription of changes:
- Added the Halloween Crypt in the second part of the world.
- Updated the title screen for Halloween (time-limited).
- The healer is now wearing a black hat (time-limited).


 - Minor spoilers incoming -

Where to find the Halloween's Crypt?
In the second part of the world map, in the South part of the Forest in which you can find Ancestral Castle, just above a shop.


What to expect from the Halloween's Crypt?
5 new story scenes
3 new normal combats
1 new boss
2 Magic Stars as a reward for beating the boss

Thanks for reading and I hope you'll like this update!

Take care,

Pablo

notes.title: Third anniversary update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A few days ago, Healer's Quest turned 3!
Happy anniversary! \o/

This is the opportunity to update the game with a new quality of life feature: you can now change the difficulty, and adjust custom rules during the course of a game. You don't need to start a new game anymore to change these options.

Just access the option screen available on the worldmap menu or on the menu before the combat. In the bottom left part of the option screen you'll find an option to change the difficulty. Clicking on it will send you to the difficulty selection screen, from which you can access the custom rules screen. Choose your new difficulty and eventually select or deselect custom rules, and you'll then be back to your game.

In addition to that, the update also comes with a few typos correction in French and German.

Thanks a lot for your support and take care,

Pablo

notes.title: World Health Day update: Introducing Custom Rules
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I hope you are well and healthy in these times.
As you may know, April 7th is the World Health Day. More than ever this means a lot to us. It’s the right time to pay homage to the people taking care of our health in real life… and in video games. :)

So today I present you the World Health Day patch for Healer’s Quest!

What’s new?
When I created Healer’s Quest, I really wanted to make a game where your decisions matter. So my orginial plan was to not implement a way to reset your skill trees. I ultimately changed my mind and added a way to do that at one given place of the game, and the process was quite expensive on purpose.

Well, I know all of us don’t enjoy video games the same way, and many of you have been asking for a more convenient way to reset all the skill trees. Yet I didn’t want to betray my original vision of the game. So I tried to find a solution to allow more people to enjoy the game, and decided to add Custom Rules on the difficulty selection screen.


By accessing the Custom Rules screen, you can choose any number of bonus amongst 4 available.

1. Special abilities of all allies will deal 2x the bonus damage. For example Tanky will have +16 bonus damage instead of +8 when he has more than 85% life.
2. All allies have +25% chances to resist abnormal statuses.
3. Pressing the “Cancel last upgrade” button on the Spell Upgrade screen will reset all Magic Stars (skill points) instead of just canceling the last ugrade.
4. You have +1 mana recovery per second

Of course I still suggest you don’t use them if you want the Healer’s Quest experience as it was originally designed, but the options are there if you want to play with them.

Have fun, and most importantly, stay safe !

Pablo

notes.title: Healer's Quest update 1.1 - Expert Mode added
notes.notes:
Hello, dear healers!

Update 1.1 is live on Steam!
This includes ground breaking changes, like the addition of the Expert Mode which allows you to play with 5 different spells instead of 4!

Patch notes 1.1.00

The EXPERT MODE has been added. You can now play Healer’s Quest with 5 spells in your spellbar instead of 4. But watch out because enemies are tougher in Expert Mode. The Classic Mode with 4 spell slots is of course still available.
I also tried to make Healer’s Quest more children-friendly by adding an option to censor the swearings and a very easy mode.
Finally, there are new rewards when completing the game, bug fixes and balance tweaks. See below for all the details.


New features:


 Added the Expert Mode : play with 5 spells in your spellbar instead of 4! Ennemis are tougher in Expert Mode.
 Added a “Very Easy” difficulty level
 Added an option to censor the (moderate) swearings (English and French only)
 Upon completing the game in normal or higher difficulty, you unlock two new voice actors for the announcements (fight, victory, defeat, etc.): Pablo Coma (myself, solo dev of the game and voice actor of the male healer) and Christelle Frédérick (voice actress of the female healer)

---


Balancing:


 Bless mana cost: 18 → 15 mana
 Shield mana cost: 18 → 15 mana
 Strength mana cost: 18 → 15 mana
 Taunt cooldown reduced by 2 seconds
 Cost for redispatching magic stars divided by 2

---


Bug fixes:


 Jumping using the keyboard now correctly gets rid of the Mana Leach abnormal status.
 Taunt cooldown was 2 seconds longer than announced by the game



I hope you’ll have fun with Healer’s Quest v1.1! :)

Pablo

notes.title: Spell balance patch (v1.0.18)
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/VFnl4iD.jpg

Greeting, healers!

Healer’s Quest released about 2 month ago, and many of you sent me feedback about what they thought about the spells balance. It’s now clear that some spells received more love from the players than others, and some of them are seen as poor choices. As the game is widely considered to be on the hard side, it make sense to leave the powerful spell as they are, and give some love to some of the weakest (or less used) ones.

The following balance patch has been made to give more relevant options to the players, hopefully making new builds viable in the highest difficulties.
I’m looking forward to your feedback, so please don’t hesitate to tell me your thoughts in the forum.

Enjoy healing!



Speed
The base mana cost per second is reduced by 2 points (10 →8).
The mana cost upgrades have been modified accordingly, further reducing it to 6 and 4 instead of 8 and 6.
The increase of the heat gauge while using Speed is now only 65% of the old value. This means Speed will take longer to become less efficient, and “Burnout” will happen much less often.

Heal First line
Base mana cost reduced by 1 point (8 → 7)
Base healing increased by 1 HP (9 → 10)
It is now clear in the description that if one of the front line allies is dead, the ally behind him will benefit from the healing (which was already the case before the update but was not mentioned).

Immune
Base mana cost reduced by 2 points (6 → 4 mana)

Taunt
Base mana cost reduced by 8 points (20 → 12 mana)

Shield
Base mana cost reduced by 2 points: 20 → 18 mana
Mana cost upgrades now reduce it to 15 and 12 instead of 17 and 14.


Bless
Base mana cost reduced by 2 points (20 → 18)
The mana cost reduction upgrade now put Bless’ mana cost to 8 instead of 10.


Strength
All passives which boost the critical strike chances now give +4% instead of +3%.
Maximum amount of bonus critical strikes chances is now +25% instead of +20%
The passive which boosts Super Move damage now gives them +33% damage instead of +25%. The sorcerer’s Super move now correctly benefits from this damage boost.


Heal
The boost upgrades now give +7 HP when a boost is performed instead of +5 HP
The secret upgrade for which you need to upgrade Boon [spoiler]now gives +12 mana instead of +10 when a boost is performed[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.14
notes.notes:
- New save game system allowing players to share, copy, backup and import their saved games on different computers. Learn more here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/598490/discussions/0/1696048426810136485/

- The boss after you finished the 5th dungeon deals slightly less damage on a certain attack.

- Fixed a bug when allies died while the Mini-Regen upgrade of the Super Heal All spell was active on them. Enemies could attack their dead bodies, and the Life spell didn’t work. All fixed.

notes.title: Post-release update and Thanks
notes.notes:
Hi, healers!

Three weeks have passed since Healer’s Quest released, and I wanted to give a big shoutout to all players! Thanks a lot for your feedback, cheers and kind words.

I took me 4 years to create the game, and I’m glad so many people are finally enjoying it right now! It’s always daunting to present our work to an audience, but the 90% positive reviews you gave to Healer’s Quest is sure something huge to me! And we’re only missing 6 reviews to hopefully reach the “very positive” score!

As far as updates go, I guess most important bugs are already fixed. I also slightly tweaked the game’s difficulty at some points where it was necessary, especially close to the end of the game. There is a couple small or very situational bugs remaining, which will be fixed as soon as possible. I’m also working on a system to let you move your saved games from a computer to another, so that’s something that should happen in the following weeks.

Thank you everyone for playing the game! Special thumbs up to players who created a guide, or beat the game, sometimes in the very hard or even impossible difficulty mode!

If you have any feedback about the game you would like to give me, feel free to leave a message in the game’s community hub, or anywhere else. Here are the different places where you can stay up to date with Healer’s Quest’s latest news:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/RabloGames 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RabloGames/
Discord channel: https://discord.gg/wHtjeAK
 
Take care,


Pablo

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.09
notes.notes:
- When retrying a combat against the guards, you could sometimes be teleported directly into the prison without any dialogs playing.
- In “Impossible” difficulty, Tanky and Grumpy are now fully healed at the beginning of the third level, so that it’s actually possible to beat the tutorial.
- When retrying the first level where the sorcerer is fighting, he is correctly back to max HP.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.08
notes.notes:
- In the Crypt, there was a bug when moving with the keyboard while the quest panel was displayed.
- French typos corrected
- Bribing a given fight in the end game made the game to soft lock.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.07
notes.notes:
- It’s not possible to bribe one of the secret boss anymore. (It wasn’t actually working, but you were still losing the gold).
- When finding the book in Classical Dungeon, the second dialog choice of the evil karma was not behaving correctly.
- Allies fallen during the combat of the boss of the second dungeon correctly gain no XP on the win screen of this combat.
- Changed the French description of the Rat Ring to make it clearer.
- Blue rats have slightly less chances to deal a special attack and when performing a special attack, the base damage is slightly reduced.
- The first Mid-Boss has slightly reduced damage on his double attack.
- After the combats in the shortcuts of Classical Dungeon, the character is at the right place on the world map.
- Tanky was gaining too many gold pieces when killing an enemy with the second hit of his Super Move.
- Added a sound when going back to the title screen from the loading screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.06
notes.notes:
- When opening a given chest in the middle game, another chest of the early game couldn’t be opened anymore.
- The font is now correct when asking for confirmation before erasing a game.
- Mashing the spell Meditate will make the healer to only say “Meditate” once, instead of stacking.
- Pressing the white flag button multiple times will not make the screen turn black anymore.
- All secret spells correctly stop Meditate’s effect.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.05
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where a given combat didn’t start.
- Fixed a bug where some end game achievement could only be unlocked in “Good” karma. They can now correctly be unlocked in any karma.
- When defeating a given boss, if Murky is casting, he correctly switches to idle pose.
- The font is now correctly set in the credits.
- The “Bribe” option is not displayed anymore during challenges (it was already deactivated, but visible).
- When getting out of the dark forest near the end of the game, the correct World Map theme is now played.
- Fixed a bug with health bars in a given Boss Fight when reviving a party member.
- If any menu is accessed before the healer’s duel, the Sorcerer’s text balloon is not in front of a health gauge anymore.

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.04
notes.notes:
- Bribing the guards in prison will now bring you to the correct level instead of the world map.
- When finishing the game with 100% completion, the percentage of completion is correctly set to 100% instead of 98%
- If you fled from the last boss encounter in the 5th dungeon, there was a gap in the storyline after beating it.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.03
notes.notes:
- The bug of the second inn crashing the game sometimes when re-entering it should be fixed.
- In the very unlikely case the second inn is still buggy, you can now press ESC to exit it when the bug happens.

Note: I have good hopes that this fix “cures” existing games that encountered the problem, but I can’t guarantee it. At least it shouldn’t happen in new games.

- Fixed a rare similar bug at the entrance of the first dungeon.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.02
notes.notes:
This update contains slight balance changes, along with some bug fixes.

- Vampires have slightly reduced chances to deal the “Vampirism” abnormal status
- When vampires cast the necromancy spell, the additional base damage is reduced. (The necromancy spell and its damages are unchanged)
- The base damage dealt by succubusses is slightly reduced.
- One of the attacks of the second boss of the 5th dungeon deals slightly less damage.
- Time between random encounters increased by 0.5 seconds on the world map. They are slightly less frequent.
- When fleeing from a fight on the world map, the time before the next encounter is now increased by 2 second.
- When bribing enemies on the world map, the time before the next encounter is now increased by 4 seconds.

Bugs:
- Fixed a rare bug where sometimes Tanky wasn’t appearing on the win screen anymore.
- A few spell upgrades allowed you to upgrade them multiple times, which basically made you waste magical stars.
- When bribing the guards, you were sometimes not redirected to the correct part of the world map.
- Implemented a fix for a bug which could occur when visiting the second inn multiple times.
- Fixed a bug with portraits in the shops near the end of the game.
- Dialog choices have now a lighter color when not hovered, to make it more obvious that it isn’t a basic dialog.
- Corrected some English typos.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.27

The dialog after the third fight of the third dungeon had a weird behavior if the archer fled from the fight.

When that effect triggers at the end of the combat, its effect will not appear anymore.
After meeting Luny, the healer passed before her while running, while he/she is behind her in the perspective.
When leveling up and gaining magic stars, the “level up” sound was played 2 times at the same time.
The Shield Ring could cause a weird behavior in one of the forest’s levels.
The fallen allies correctly getup after the fight in specific level where there is a dialog after the combat
The ink abnormal status tutorial correctly plays the first time one of your allies is hit by it.

When selected a dark skin tone for the healer, the skin color became too blueish during night scene.

notes.title: Healer's Quest - patch notes v0.9.16
notes.notes:
Random encounters on the world map happen slightly less often (0.5 to 1 second additional time between two encounters)

When using boost on an ally with the keyboard, the heal animation is now correctly played if the key is hold.

When using boost and then releasing the mouse button, a frame where the healer is bringing his wand down is played instead of being immediately idle.

Boost cannot be cast on dead allies anymore

When casting Heal, then selecting another spell with the keyboard and releasing the mouse button, the heal animation correctly stops.

When casting Heal and passing from one character to another with the keyboard with a very strict timing, the heal animation sometimes went into idle pose.

Added a smoke effect on the wand when it reaches burnout (overheat) state.

Fixed a bug with the heat gauge, where the gauge was full but never reached overheat stage.

French typos corrected

The “burnout” sound has been updated

One level in the Graveyard is harder.
